enrollmentToken.title: EraseAI enrollment token
enrollmentToken.description: From EraseAI > Organization > Managed rollout. Starts with eae_. Enrolls this browser in your organization so nobody has to paste an API key.

userEmail.title: Work email (optional)
userEmail.description: The person's work email. If not set, the extension asks for it once. It must be on one of the organization's allowed domains.
